card.name: The verb administer in training instructions
card.fires_on: The verb "administer" (or nearby "use" and "by") in instructions about training patients or caregivers to give a drug, especially insulin by injection after pump therapy.

modes.label: Train to administer insulin
modes.description: "administer" after "trained to" or "train patients to" in insulin pump warnings.
modes.example: Patients using continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion pump therapy must be trained to<< administer>> insulin by injection and have alternate insulin therapy

modes.label: Other administration wording
modes.description: "by", "use" or "administer" in how-to-give statements about route or self-use.
modes.example: to be administered<< by>> intravenous infusion over 30 minutes
